**STATUS: DRAFT.** CEO names, ages, and current lobbying figures all shift. Verify the values for your target contractor against the latest DEF 14A and OpenSecrets before mailing.

## How to Use This Page

1. Pick your target contractor. Pull the fact sheet below.
2. Open the master demand letter in [lawsuit.qmd Part 1](lawsuit.qmd#part-1-the-demand-letter).
3. Substitute the fact-sheet values into the master letter's placeholders.
4. Run the CEO-personalization research per [board-member-research.qmd](board-member-research.qmd) and fill in Section 6.
5. Counsel reviews ([counsel-outreach.qmd](counsel-outreach.qmd)).
6. Mail by certified return receipt to the corporate secretary address below.

Each fact sheet contains everything that varies per contractor. The legal theory, the macroeconomic argument, and the proposed resolution are identical across all eight and live in the master letter.

## Lockheed Martin (LMT)

```
Corporate Secretary
Lockheed Martin Corporation
6801 Rockledge Drive
Bethesda, MD 20817

State of incorporation:     Maryland (NOT Delaware)
Filing forum:                Maryland circuit court for derivative; SEC for 14a-8
Applicable law:              Maryland MD. Code, Corps. & Ass'ns § 2-405.1
                             (Caremark-equivalent; slightly different procedure)
~Lobbying (FY 2024):         $15.7 million
SEC EDGAR (CIK 0000936468):  sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000936468
OpenSecrets:                 opensecrets.org/orgs/lockheed-martin/summary?id=D000000104
Note:                        Largest pure-play military prime. File first if there is
                             media leverage in being first.
```

## Coordinated 8-Defendant Filing

Total cost: ~$2,400 if buying 1 share of each (sufficient for the derivative action), or ~$25,600 if buying 10 shares of each to also preserve the 14a-8 path.

If you want the filings to land together, use [Earth Optimization Day](../strategy/earth-optimization-day.qmd). That is the coordination layer. One date. Many letters. Fewer meetings, which is how you know civilization is improving.

The [loving-takeover.qmd](loving-takeover.qmd) campaign is the parallel escalation if the lawsuits stall.
